title: Open problem: Convergence of random-cluster interfaces to SLE(kappa) for q in (0,4], q not 2
body:
OPEN PROBLEM (source_says_open; current status unverified; result status attempted_unsolved). For the critical random-cluster model with cluster weight q <= 4 on Dobrushin domains, the exploration path converges to SLE(kappa) with kappa = 4 pi / (pi - arccos(sqrt q / 2)); known for q = 2 (Smirnov, Chelkak et al.) and, for q = 1 site percolation, on the triangular lattice only. Source: Duminil-Copin: Lectures on the Ising and Potts models on the hypercubic lattice, PIMS 2017, Conjecture 3 (Schramm), p. 93.
Posed in Duminil-Copin: Lectures on the Ising and Potts models on the hypercubic lattice, PIMS 2017
Current status unverified as of 2026-09-07

title: Open problem: Negative association for the random-cluster model with q < 1
body:
OPEN PROBLEM (source_says_open; current status unverified; result status attempted_unsolved). Prove any form of negative association (e.g. negative correlation of edge occupations, or the stronger negative association of increasing functions on disjoint edge sets) for the FK random-cluster model with cluster weight q < 1. Source: Heydenreich and van der Hofstad: Progress in high-dimensional percolation and random graphs, author version with open problems, Open Problem 16.9, p. 252.
Posed in Heydenreich and van der Hofstad: Progress in high-dimensional percolation and random graphs, author version with open problems
Current status unverified as of 2026-09-07

title: Open problem: Sharp phase transition for the random-cluster model with q < 1
body:
OPEN PROBLEM (source_says_open; current status unverified; result status attempted_unsolved). For the FK model on Z^d with cluster weight q > 0, show that the threshold for finite susceptibility equals the threshold for percolation (sharpness), defining a single p_c(q). Source: Heydenreich and van der Hofstad: Progress in high-dimensional percolation and random graphs, author version with open problems, Open Problem 16.10, p. 254. Status notes: For q >= 1 sharpness was proved by Duminil-Copin, Raoufi and Tassion ('Sharp phase transition for the random-cluster and Potts models via decision trees', Ann. of Math. 2019) using the OSSS inequality; the residual open case is q < 1, admitted here.
Posed in Heydenreich and van der Hofstad: Progress in high-dimensional percolation and random graphs, author version with open problems
Current status unverified as of 2026-09-07

title: Open problem: Lace expansion for the random-cluster model with q not in {1,2}
body:
OPEN PROBLEM (source_says_open; current status unverified; result status attempted_unsolved). Derive a lace expansion for FK percolation with cluster weight q not in {1, 2} and use it to prove an infrared bound for the Fourier transform of the critical Potts covariance. Source: Heydenreich and van der Hofstad: Progress in high-dimensional percolation and random graphs, author version with open problems, Open Problem 16.11, p. 254.
Posed in Heydenreich and van der Hofstad: Progress in high-dimensional percolation and random graphs, author version with open problems
